description: (needs account token) Asks search engines to skip a claimed site, or to list it again. mode is allow or noindex. Claim the site first. Does not charge.

mode.description: allow lists the site. noindex asks search engines to skip it.

site.description: The address of a claimed site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
